A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''attendant''' served the [[Grand Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], [[Darish Vol]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The attendant greeted [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] when she arrived at the [[Circle of Lords]]. He was very strong, muscular, and attractive according to Khai, and she wondered why he was merely an attendant.
